mapper.sql: v.*, c.customer_nickname AS customer_name, c.customer_avatar AS customer_avatar, c.customer_phone AS customer_phone, a.agent_name AS agent_name, a.agent_phone AS agent_phone, a.agent_avatar AS agent_avatar, h.house_title AS house_title, h.house_address AS house_address, CASE WHEN ar.review_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS agent_review_submitted

FROM h_viewing v LEFT JOIN sys_customer c ON v.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_agent a ON v.agent_id = a.agent_id LEFT JOIN h_house h ON v.house_id = h.house_id LEFT JOIN h_review ar ON ar.viewing_id = v.viewing_id AND ar.review_target_type = 2
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id AS id, c.customer_nickname AS nickname, c.customer_phone AS phone, c.customer_status AS status FROM h_viewing v INNER JOIN sys_customer c ON v.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE v.agent_id = #{agentId} AND c.customer_status = 1 ORDER BY c.customer_nickname
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO h_viewing ( customer_id, agent_id, house_id, viewing_appoint_time, viewing_address, viewing_status, viewing_cancel_reason, viewing_cancel_by_type, viewing_cancel_by_id, viewing_remark, customer_phone ) VALUES ( #{customerId}, #{agentId}, #{houseId}, #{appointTime}, #{viewingAddress}, #{status}, #{cancelReason}, #{cancelByType}, #{cancelById}, #{remark}, #{customerPhone} )
